text_block_list.text:
I appreciate your help. I'll go and rest a
while.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text: Hayahide... Hey, Hayahide...
Hm? I hear a girl's voice...
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
Yeah, that'd be me! Yer favorite pair'a
glasses!
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ's Glasses

text_block_list.text: M-my glasses can talk?!
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
Uh... What is it? Can I help you with
something?
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
Aw, I jus' wanted ta thank ya for always
showing
me such amazing sights! ♪
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ's Glasses

text_block_list.text:
I'm... sorry? I don't recall showing you
anything in
particular.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
Aw, sure ya have! I love seeing yer
thrilling races
and all yer fans' smiles.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ's Glasses

text_block_list.text:
Not ta mention yer fierce rivalries and
the way
the finish line looks as we rush
toward it!
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ's Glasses

text_block_list.text:
And ta think I get to see it all from the
best seat
in the house! Why, I'm jus' over
the moon thankful
for ya! Heehee!
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ's Glasses

text_block_list.text:
No, it is I who should be thanking you,
my dear
ally.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
Whenever I'm feeling too hopeless to
focus on
what's ahead... or I become
overconfident in
victory and lose sight of
my goals...
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
You're always there to help me clear my
vision
and show me the path to victory!
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
I hope we can continue supporting each
other for
a long time. Hehe!
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
Don't you even think about cheatin' on
me with
contact lenses!
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ's Glasses

text_block_list.text: Eeeeek!
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text: Wh-what kind of dream was that?
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
Бива Хаяхидэ feels refreshed by the
sweet
dream.

Бива Хаяхидэ feels disturbed by the
strange
dream...
